title: FOIA Response Redaction
description: Redact exempt information from public records requests — names, addresses, case numbers — before release.

title: Citizen Records Processing
description: Remove PII from benefit applications, tax filings, and permit documents when transferring between agencies.

title: Law Enforcement Reports
description: Redact witness identities, victim information, and officer details from incident reports shared publicly.

title: Contract & Procurement
description: Strip proprietary terms and personal data from bids, contracts, and procurement documents before public disclosure.

title: Inter-Agency Data Sharing
description: Redact sensitive fields from datasets shared across departments while keeping operational data intact.

title: Public Meeting Records
description: Remove citizen PII from meeting transcripts and correspondence before posting to public portals.
